checks.detail: prd_implementation_review=pass; visual_direction=conformant; state_coverage_gap=tracked_open. Bound receipts show every blocking runtime check green: fresh build from source, session/window/renderer, embedded assets, product-UI separation, isolated native SQLite store, binary and source unchanged, plus 46/46 rust unit tests, tsc, vite build, cargo fmt/check. Visual review of the bound 1280x800 captures: auth shell is a calm editorial cream canvas with amber accent and no prohibited patterns; all six section-8 surfaces (Today, Inbox, Projects, Calendar, Focus, Settings) render hydrated with correct headings in two independent runs and today.png is byte-identical across runs; the validation capture preserves typed input with a field-level actionable message; Inbox shows search plus priority/due/completion filters; Today shows due/focus-work/done sections with a completion summary; Projects shows Planned/In progress/Done columns with rename/archive/restore; Calendar shows month+agenda toggle with the due/reminder chip on Sep 19; Settings shows profile, timezone, reminder toggle, password policy, sessions, and reminder-deliveries. The self-drive probe is opt-in only (hidden non-focusable trigger, backend drive_not_started gate, per-run drive accounts, booleans-only email check across IPC) with no default-startup mutations. Residual: PRD 9.2 recovery/responsive and email-action states remain runtime-uncaptured — tracked evidence debt (fnd.loop16.state-board-states-uncaptured), not an observed product failure.

prd_golden_path=fail; journey_receipt_missing; cause=infrastructure_lane. White-box layer verified: 46/46 unit tests cover register→verify→sign-in→quick-add→restart persistence, single-use/expiring plus tampered/expired/reused link tokens, generic rate-limited auth errors, private-operation rejection, subtask scoping, and the v3 migration. Black-box layer partial: the host drove the anonymous shell with W3C typed input (labels intact, actionable validation), observed the advisory 16/16 self-drive conclude in ~5.3s (renderer-self-drive-ipc, explicitly untrusted authority), and captured all six signed-in surfaces hydrated post-drive. Still absent from both receipts: typed registration through the real UI, following an email action link as a user, the reminder-email journey, and sign-out/sign-in persistence as external UI actions; external_deeplink is not_run and the fixed collector scenario contains no such stages — exactly the host-lane gap predicted by the frozen risk handoff, which the recapture was supposed to close and did not. Disposition: explicit blocked/missing-evidence failure of the criterion, not an observed product defect; see fnd.loop16.section3-external-journey-unproven.
